data.name: Fidaa’ātun
data.gender_notes: Fidaa’ātun is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who gives and devotes herself to a cause, or is committed to a religion. The name Fidaa’ātun carries the meaning “One who gives, devotes” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fidaa’ātun usually hope their child will grow to embody one who gives, devotes and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: To be steadfast and committed to one's faith
data.etymology: Fidaa’ātun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “One who gives, devotes.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fidaa’ātun total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: فِدَاءَاتن
in_arabic.long_meaning: فِدَاءَاتن هو الاسم الذكوري من أصل فِعْلِيّ، وهو مُشتقّ من الجذر ف د ع، والجذر ف د ع يُشير إلى الفِداء والمَغفِرَة، وهو من الأسماء التي أذكى بها النبي ﷺ عَلَيهِ الصلاة والسلام، وتُعتبر هذه الأسماء مُقدسة في الإسلام، ويُعتقد أنّ هذه الأسماء تُبعث في الجنة، ويُعتبر الفِداءَاتن من أهمّ الأسماء التي تُرمز إلى الفِداء والمَغفِرَة، وأيضًا يُعتبر الفِداءَاتن من الأسماء التي تُربط بالتَفكير والجدّية، ويُعتبر المُصطفيون المُتّبعون للدين الإسلامي، يُفضلون هذه الأسماء على غيرها، ويُعتقد أنّ هذه الأسماء تُمنح المُصطفيين مَغفِرَةً وَرَحمةً من الله تَعَالى

It is believed that the name Fidaa'tun will bring blessings and protection to the bearer. The name is also associated with the concept of Zakat, which is one of the Five Pillars of Islam. In modern times, the name Fidaa'tun has become popular among Muslims as it is seen as a symbol of generosity and compassion.
